test_case.test_name: Intel PTAT mode-3 4500mb continuous one-hour memory stress with independent RAS supervision
test_case.purpose: Exercise the intended memory scope with the approved PTAT mode-3 4500mb profile for one continuous hour and prove meaningful allocation/load completes without hang, OOM, unacceptable thermal behavior or new memory/RAS error.
required_package: Authorized pinned Intel PTAT binary/package, license, checksum and supported platform/OS matrix
Release-specific help/documentation proving -mt 3 and -mtsize 4500mb units, total-versus-per-worker scope and worker behavior
DIMM/socket/channel inventory, available-memory baseline and approved OS/control-plane headroom
Project-approved allocation/utilization floor, heartbeat cadence, memory temperature and ECC/RAS/MCE/EDAC/OOM/log limits
Dedicated one-hour window, independent hard watchdog, BMC/OOB access, abort and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Verify PTAT identity/support and capture its release-specific help for -mt/-mtsize. Record DIMM topology, available/resident memory, temperatures, ECC/RAS/MCE/EDAC/kernel/SEL baselines and a non-destructive log marker. Under the approved hard watchdog run exactly `./ptat -mt 3 -mtsize 4500mb` for 3600 continuous seconds, retaining complete stdout/stderr/exit and sampling process liveness, actual allocation/utilization, host heartbeat, memory/platform temperatures and error sources. Stop at the approved limit, then capture bounded deltas, restored memory availability and post-health.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized profile remains continuously active for the full 3600 seconds, demonstrates the release-defined 4500mb allocation and approved utilization floor, and completes successfully. The host remains responsive, memory/thermal/error measures stay within approved limits, no OOM or unaccepted ECC/RAS/MCE/EDAC/kernel/SEL event appears, and post-stress health is intact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires artifact/profile identity, vendor-proven option semantics, a gap-free 3600-second timeline, measured allocation/utilization at the approved floor, successful PTAT output/exit, continuous heartbeat and all health/error results within approved limits. A zero exit, shorter run or unverified 4500mb meaning cannot pass. Missing numeric thresholds is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Validate the licensed binary and platform support; do not execute an unknown PTAT build or inferred option meaning
Confirm sufficient OS/control-plane headroom and independent BMC/OOB recovery before allocating memory
Use a hard watchdog and abort on OOM, hang, heartbeat loss, thermal limit or new ECC/RAS/MCE/EDAC event
Preserve logs with markers, allow cooldown/recovery and never auto-retry or clear evidence
expected_evidence: PTAT license/version/hash/support matrix and release help for -mt 3/-mtsize 4500mb
DIMM topology, available-memory/headroom and pre-stress thermal/error state
Exact command plus gap-free 3600-second PTAT output/exit and watchdog timeline
Time-aligned allocation/utilization/heartbeat and memory/platform thermal telemetry
ECC/RAS/MCE/EDAC/kernel/SEL delta, post-memory availability/health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On OOM, thermal/error limit, hang or watchdog loss, terminate PTAT through the approved supervisor when possible, preserve the partial timeline and use OOB for the separately approved recovery. Verify memory availability, ECC/RAS and platform health after cooldown; do not retry or reboot automatically.
